humidity.note: MEDA local relative humidity (%RH), resolved from the official bundle documentation; the product XML omits its unit. Martínez et al. (2023), section 2, identifies ice as the saturation reference. Earth uses a separate 2 m RH product; a common saturation reference has not been established, so no direct difference is calculated.

reflectivity.label: TES orbital albedo
reflectivity.note: Published regional retrieval, 0.25–2.9 µm, around 14:00 local true solar time; about 300 km². Martínez et al. (2023), section 4 / figure 14. Separate from the missing MEDA sol 300 albedo; excluded from match scores.

uv.label: MEDA recorded UV detector flux
uv.note: Sol 300, RDS TOP 3, 250–400 nm, ±15° field of view. Highest recorded ten-minute mean; incomplete daily coverage. A detector flux, not a UV index or hemispherical daily exposure; excluded from match scores.
